title: MoT token routing and Context Correction with shared translator Views
hypothesis: For a fixed Pythia-70M→SmolLM2-135M pair, a two-expert token-routed translator with target-side context-correction training can be represented by one shared rank-r map basis and small expert coordinates, retaining target quality while reducing actual translator payload bytes versus independent full expert maps.
prior_art_boundary: PA238 MoT uses token-level Top-K routing over recurrent cross-attention translators and a target-side context correction loss. This component screen retains token-level Top-1 routing and post-translation target KV trajectory correction, but uses affine ridge translator experts and one-token probes. It is not a full MoT paper reproduction. PA237 remains the weighted-ridge mapper control.
physical_object: Two per-role affine KV translator experts fit from disjoint context subsets for one ordered model pair.
logical_multiplicity: Token-level router selects one of two translator functional views from source cache state and normalized target role.
mirror_coordinate: Rank-r coefficients for each target layer/head/KV-role expert map in one shared PCA basis; the same token router and target-side correction objective are used for full and compressed banks.

fixed_design.expert_fit: independent attention-weighted affine ridge maps fit on disjoint calibration prompt sets; alpha=0.01
fixed_design.normalization: inverse source and target RoPE before key fitting; target RoPE after key translation
fixed_design.router: shared MLP, input source 64D key/value token vector plus normalized target layer/head/KV role (67D), hidden width 16, two scores, deterministic straight-through Top-1
fixed_design.router_optimizer: Adam lr=0.001, 24 updates; target weights and translators frozen
fixed_design.router_objective: normalized tokenwise target-KV MSE + 0.10 normalized target replay-query KV correction loss + 0.05 next-token CE
fixed_design.context_correction: after injecting translated prefix KV, replay the query token in the target; match all target-layer K/V for that query position to native target prefill K/V

development.rank_selection: lowest mean factorized-MoT next-token NLL; ties to smaller rank

fresh.prompt_eligibility: 16–128 tokens and exact source/target tokenizer offset equality
fresh.selection: three seed-disjoint 12-prompt chunks from deterministic pair-specific permutation

controls: Single independent weighted-ridge map fit on all 12 calibration prompts, no router
Native MoT-style two-independent-expert bank with token-level Top-1 router and target context correction
Shared rank-r expert maps using the same token router and context correction objective (ordinary low-rank/PCA coefficient control)
primary_metrics: per-query target-layer KV context-correction relative MSE
translator application time and correction-train compute time
success_gate: For all three fresh seeds, shared-view MoT NLL is within +0.50 nat of full two-expert MoT, within +1.00 nat of single full ridge and native target prefill; shared-view full inference payload is at least 50% smaller than full MoT payload.
failure_gate: Any quality or storage gate miss. A route collapse is reported even if quality passes.
mirror_specific_boundary: The shared PCA expert-code representation is identical to conventional low-rank coefficient coding; any pass is an ordinary shared-basis compression result, not Mirror-specific, unless it exceeds that control at matched bytes and compute.

shared_view_paid_state: shared expert-map mean and rank-r basis
storage.common_model_weights: reported separately and excluded from marginal translator payload

report: router/context-correction training wall time and updates
per-token router plus expert application time

scope: One ordered model pair and Wikitext-2.
Two affine ridge translator experts, one-token test probes and 12 calibration prompts per fresh seed.
No multi-token completion trajectory or full MoT paper-reproduction claim.
